channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Apple enters John Ternus era as AI challenges and memory crunch intensify
item.description: John Ternus' first day as Apple CEO comes at a critical juncture for the iPhone maker, with memory prices soaring and AI challenges looming.

item.title: 10-year yield hits highest since January 2025 as higher oil prices stoke inflation worries
item.description: Treasury yields increased on Tuesday as investors monitored a reignition of tensions in the Middle East.

item.title: Canada's Carney slaps Trump admin for 'doing memes ... throwing shade'
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said, "It's beneath their office' when asked about Trump Cabinet secretaries insulting his nation's military.

item.title: AI token prices are hitting new record lows
item.description: A closely followed measure of artificial intelligence token prices touched fresh lows.

item.title: Dow drops 400 points after U.S. confirms new attacks on Iran targets; oil and yields rise: Live updates
item.description: Stocks fell on Tuesday, the first day of September, as inflation worries and elevated oil prices lifted bond yields in the U.S. and abroad.

item.title: Watch out: These stocks could succumb to margin pressure
item.description: Some companies may not be able to keep expanding their margins, according to Trivariate Research.

item.title: Global bond yields soar to multi-decade highs as Middle East turmoil reignites inflation fears
item.description: Bond yields surged across major markets Tuesday as U.S.-Iran hostilities revived energy and inflation risks, with Japan and U.K. yields at multi-decade highs.

item.title: Crypto enters September with legislative policy gamble hanging by a thread
item.description: Comprehensive industry legislation teeters on the brink amid growing doubts the bill will cross the finish line.

item.title: Brent hits highest level since July following latest U.S. attacks against Iran; WTI up 4%
item.description: Oil prices extended gains Tuesday as tensions in the Middle East escalated, with the U.S. carrying out new strikes against Iran.

item.title: Fed Governor Barr says he'll support rate hike if inflation doesn't ease
item.description: The policymaker said he's concerned about "broader price pressures taking hold" as inflation has prevailed above the Fed's 2% target.

item.title: Used cars under $20,000 tend to sell quickly — but there are trade-offs for buyers
item.description: The share of used cars listed at under $20,000 has dropped from pre-pandemic levels against a backdrop of high inflation.

item.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it
item.description: The colorful "Microduck" robot from HuggingFace's French subsidiary Pollen Robotics has sold more than 10,000 units since launching on Thursday.

item.title: Softbank's SB Energy files for IPO, says it's 'substantially dependent' on OpenAI
item.description: SB Energy hasn't generated any revenue from its data center business, and none of its data centers are operational yet.

item.title: Waymo and Zoox expand into more U.S. markets as robotaxi race heats up
item.description: Waymo is bringing driverless rides to three more cities, and Amazon plans to start testing in two additional U.S. markets.

item.title: U.S. House aims to avoid government shutdown amid GOP hard-liner resistance
item.description: The U.S. House on Tuesday is expected to vote on a short-term spending measure that would avoid a government shutdown until after November's midterm election.

item.title: New data shows this language learning stock can bounce back, Evercore ISI says
item.description: An Evercore ISI poll shows Duolingo's AI products are being well received by users, which should allow the firm to keep dominating the language learning space.

item.title: Toyota's hybrid RAV4 is in demand as dealers wait for more supply
item.description: When Toyota announced the new version of its SUV, it said the RAV4 would only be available as a hybrid and that production would be limited at first.

item.title: Trump says U.S. growth could hit 20%. It’s happened only once since WWII
item.description: Trump argued rapid growth should not prompt Fed rate hikes, even as inflation remains above the central bank’s 2% target.

item.title: Trump to meet with U.S. oil refiners as White House pushes to lower gas prices
item.description: The White House says it is seeking near-term steps to boost refining capacity as affordability and gas prices loom over the midterm election.

item.title: Tropical Storm Edouard could reach hurricane strength as it approaches Texas and Louisiana
item.description: Tropical Storm Edouard was expected to strengthen significantly and possibly reach hurricane force Tuesday as it moved toward the Gulf Coast.

item.title: Jim Cramer says selling Amazon shares over new FTC lawsuit would be 'hysterical'
item.description: The Investing Club holds its "Morning Meeting" every weekday at 10:20 a.m. ET.

item.title: The best personal loans with no origination fee of 2026
item.description: Origination fees can run up to 10% of your loan amount and can eat into your funding.

item.title: How one of the largest investors in student housing is playing this school year
item.description: Mike Gordon of Harrison Street Asset Management said funding cuts and enrollment trends are making specialization more vital than ever.

item.title: Students are reconsidering their majors, career paths and industries due to AI: CNBC survey
item.description: As AI continues to reshape industries, some students are wondering what their careers will look like once they graduate.

item.title: Livestream shopping is gaining steam in the U.S., thanks to apps like TikTok and Whatnot
item.description: Whatnot and TikTok are tapping into its potential livestream shopping in the U.S. after a decade of massive success in China.

item.title: OneRail launches AI platform with Nvidia for retailers to make faster delivery decisions
item.description: Last-mile delivery company OneRail is launching a new platform with Nvidia to use AI to help retailers make faster and more efficient delivery decisions.

item.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia it won't get economic relief until it ends Ukraine war
item.description: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

item.title: One aerospace stock got hit by a SpaceX announcement. Two analysts say buy the dip
item.description: A slump in Howmet Aerospace after SpaceX said it would bring turbine-blade production in-house presents a buying opportunity, two Wall Street banks say.

item.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi asks Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
item.description: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.

item.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
item.description: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.
